description: This Java class 'ImmutableConnectionFailure' provides an immutable implementation of a connection failure, including details such as cause, description, and timestamp, with methods for generating failure status, description, and standard object methods.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionFailure
classes.description: An immutable class representing a connection failure with cause, description, and timestamp, implementing ConnectionFailure interface.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns a Status.Failure object encapsulating the cause of the failure.

methods.name: getFailureDescription
methods.description: Generates a detailed string description of the failure, including cause, description, and timestamp.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on cause, description, and time.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on cause, description, and time.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object with cause, description, and time.
